105)tshogs kyi mchod pa la/bā la dang ma dā na sogs tshogs par byas nas/ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/tshogs gzhong pad+ma 'bar ba'i nang*/tshogs rdzes rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyur/ /

tei:div.tei:p: tshogs kyi mchod pa la/ bā la dang ma dā na sogs tshogs par byas nas/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ tshogs gzhong pad+ma 'bar ba'i nang*/ tshogs rdzes rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyur// oṃ aḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ spyan 'dren ni/ oṃ/ bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil// ye shes bzhi 'phro 'khor lo'i tshul// tshogs mchog dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ya hi ma ha ma 'a ru ṇi ka sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya stam/ spyir mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ nas/ shab+da/ ru sa/ shab+ta/ ghanadhe/ ra pa/ spar+she/ ka ma gu ṇa pra tits+tsha swa ha/ tshogs phud cha gsum gyi dang po mchod pa ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa ni// gus pa'i blo yi 'bul lags na// dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhes su gsol// ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha hi/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// sgo gsum mi shes bag med pas// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis (106)pa/ de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ yig brgya bzla/ tha ma bsgral bstab pa ni/ badz+ra ma hā shṝ he ru ka konyaham̐/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hūm̐/ nga ni za byed chen po ste// khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang*// gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir// sha rus la sogs gza' bar byed/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dug lngas gzir zhing mnar ba dang*/ gdug cing gtum pa'i sems can rnams// bdag med dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir// 'dod yon dam tshig chen poraspungs// ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ lha tshogs thams cad rang rang gi phyag rgya snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ros tshims par gyur/ tshogs drang ba ni/ ho/ tshogs kyi mchod pa brgyan du rol/ a la la ho/ gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub la sogs 'don la gsol ba gdab/ smon lam ni/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba yis//

sogs smon lam gdab/ lhag ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ pheṃḥ hūm̐/ sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam bcas (107 108)bzhin// dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi nyul ba'i// lhag gtor dbang ba'i srung ma rnams// 'di bzhes bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling ta khā hi/ zhes pa'ang gzhung la.a mdor bsdus te 'jam dpal grub pa'i blo gros gyis bgyis pa'o/ dge'o// sarba maṅga laṃ//
